a1Precise.label: Precise Movement
a1Precise.reason: The ATK bonus starts only after her Swift Stormflight hits and ends with her Nightsoul's Blessing, while her main damage is her Burst, cast before it; its Constellation 2 part goes to the active party member.

c6Extreme.label: Constellation 6 Extreme Force
c6Extreme.reason: A Constellation 6 bonus for the active party member when her Nightsoul points overflow, which depends on the team.
